{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.52

|arg= global

|gr1= Turrets

|descr= Returns all magazines (including empty) from all vehicle turrets (including driver turret [-1]) and their ammo counts. Since Arma 3 v2.08.148327 it is possible to exclude person turrets from returned results.

|s1= [[magazinesAllTurrets]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - vehicle with turrets

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s with [className, turretPath, ammoCount, id, creator]
* className: [[String]] - magazine class name
* turretPath: [[Turret Path]]
* ammoCount: [[Number]] - how many rounds left in the magazine
* id: [[Number]] - id of the magazine object. The number starts at 10,000,000. This gives it about 6,700,000 possible ids before the number starts losing precision and cannot be used in scripts.
* creator: [[Number]] - [[owner]] / [[clientOwner]] of the PC that created the object

|s2= [[magazinesAllTurrets]] [vehicle, excludePersonTurrets]

|s2since= arma3 2.08

|p21= vehicle: [[Object]] - vehicle with turrets

|p22= excludePersonTurrets: [[Boolean]] - when [[true]] only vehicle's turrets are queried

|r2= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s with [className, turretPath, ammoCount, id, creator]
* className: [[String]] - magazine class name
* turretPath: [[Turret Path]]
* ammoCount: [[Number]] - how many rounds left in the magazine
* id: [[Number]] - id of the magazine object. The number starts at 10,000,000. This gives it about 6,700,000 possible ids before the number starts losing precision and cannot be used in scripts.
* creator: [[Number]] - [[owner]] / [[clientOwner]] of the PC that created the object

|x1= <sqf>_mags = magazinesAllTurrets vehicle player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_mags = magazinesAllTurrets [vehicle player, true];</sqf>

|seealso= [[magazinesTurret]] [[allTurrets]] [[addMagazineTurret]] [[removeMagazinesTurret]] [[removeMagazineTurret]] [[weaponsTurret]] [[loadMagazine]] [[magazines]] [[magazinesDetail]] [[magazinesAmmo]] [[magazinesAmmoFull]] [[addWeaponTurret]] [[removeWeaponTurret]] [[turretLocal]] [[getPylonMagazines]] [[ammoOnPylon]]
}}
